title: Pregnancy Recipes: Iron-and-Folate Bowls You Can Cook in 30 Minutes
excerpt: Three tasty recipes pairing heme/non-heme iron with vitamin C — Vietnamese-inspired bowls with clear amounts and food-safety notes.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, it's essential to provide your body with enough iron and folate. Iron helps create red blood cells, while folate supports the development of your baby. In this article, we'll introduce three recipes rich in iron and folate that can be cooked in under 30 minutes.

## Nutrient Analysis
Iron and folate are two crucial nutrients for pregnant women. Iron can be found in foods like red meat, chicken, fish, and leafy greens. Folate can be found in leafy greens, fruits, and whole grains.

## Recipe 1: Grilled Chicken and Spinach Bowl
* 100g grilled chicken
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup cooked spinach
* 1 lemon
* Salt and pepper

Grilled chicken is an excellent source of iron, while spinach is rich in folate. Lemon provides vitamin C, which helps increase iron absorption.

## Recipe 2: Grilled Fish and Bina Bowl
* 100g grilled fish
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup cooked bina
* 1 lemon
* Salt and pepper

Grilled fish is a good source of iron and folate, while bina is rich in folate. Lemon provides vitamin C, which helps increase iron absorption.

## Recipe 3: Beef and Vegetable Stir-Fry Bowl
* 100g beef stir-fry
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup cooked mixed vegetables
* 1 lemon
* Salt and pepper

Beef stir-fry is an excellent source of iron, while mixed vegetables are rich in folate. Lemon provides vitamin C, which helps increase iron absorption.

## Food Safety Notes
When pregnant, it's crucial to ensure food safety. Avoid eating foods like sushi, sashimi, and raw meat. Cook food until it reaches a safe internal temperature.

## Conclusion
These three recipes provide a rich source of iron and folate, supporting the health of pregnant women. Remember to follow food safety guidelines and cook food until it reaches a safe internal temperature. For more information on prenatal nutrition, visit our [prenatal nutrition category](/blog/prenatal-nutrition).

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about prenatal nutrition, consult your doctor or a registered dietitian. They can provide you with personalized information and guidance to help you maintain optimal health throughout your pregnancy.

faqs.question: Why are iron and folate important for pregnant women?
faqs.answer: Iron and folate are two crucial nutrients for pregnant women. Iron helps create red blood cells, while folate supports the development of the baby.

faqs.question: How can I increase iron absorption?
faqs.answer: Vitamin C can help increase iron absorption. Eat foods rich in vitamin C like lemons, oranges, and bell peppers along with iron-rich foods.

faqs.question: Can I eat sushi and sashimi while pregnant?
faqs.answer: No, avoid eating foods like sushi and sashimi while pregnant. They may contain harmful bacteria and parasites that can affect the health of the mother and baby.
